text:
Ava: N-Judah stuck at Judah & 9th, signal trouble. ~25-30m delay. Shoes soaked. Anyone near Embarcadero taking the ferry?
Devon: Ugh, thanks for the heads-up. Can probably swing by Embarcadero in 10 — need an umbrella? :umbrella:
Priya: I have an extra compact umbrella on desk 3F. @Ava come grab it, no drama.
Sam: Vote: should we hide an office umbrella stash in the lobby? :raised_hands: (poll: yes/no)
Mina: Also saw a 15m Caltrain delay this morning fwiw. Travel chaos.
commute-bot: [incident] N-Judah signal issue at Judah & 9th — cleared at 10:18. Residual delays ~5-10m.
Ava: Saved by Priya's umbrella, grabbing it now. Thanks!! :heart:
Devon: OK now we need a 'muddy shoes' rack by the mop closet. Who's in?
Priya: Vote +1 for shoe rack. Also towel rotation? not joking.
Sam: I’ll sponsor a "commute survival kit" basket: tape, napkins, cheap flip-flops. Happy to fund first round.
Mina: If we do an umbrella stash pls add a sticky: 'take one, return one' :memo:
Devon: Also — we could hook commute-bot up to Caltrain/BART webhooks and push realtime pings to #random. Anyone want to trial it?
Ava: @Devon do it. +1. Commute-bot is already too opinionated :sweat_smile:
Sam: Quick how-to command for the bot (if anyone wants to subscribe):
```
/commute subscribe #random bart caltrain n-judah
```
Mina: Love it. If bot spams, we can always mute the channel. :grimacing: 
Priya: This thread turned into good office ops. We should make a little sign: 'commuter supplies — be kind, go barefoot if needed' :laughing:
Devon: Final: umbrella stash + shoe rack + Sam's survival kit. I'll DM facilities to get a small shelf. :thumbsup:
